clips.title: The story
paras: In Mulgore’s eastern cliffs, the Venture Co. Mine cuts into land the tauren refused to surrender. The goblin company digs for minerals without permission, threatening the plains’ natural balance.

The Venture Company tunnels through Mulgore’s eastern mountain wall despite the tauren’s refusal to grant mining rights. Supervisor Fizsprocket directs the work. Three entrances serve the complex: a ground tunnel guarded by hired muscle, a cliffside overlook, and an upper passage that leads to a small lumber camp. Machines, smoke, and slag heaps scar land the tauren hold sacred.
